sourceText: Operator, 2026-08-17: after a latency audit of done_prepare, "story 把第 1 项（routine validate 复用 runScheduled 调度器）做掉" (turn the first optimisation item - routine validate reusing the runScheduled scheduler - into a story and do it), followed by "继续把，直到 B-7dff done 为止，并且别让我做决定，按照整个流程来" (keep going until B-7dff is done, do not make me decide, follow the whole process).
normalizedOutcome: lattice validate executes its configured command plan through the shared keyed parallel scheduler instead of a sequential loop, so a full routine validate finishes in roughly the duration of its slowest single command instead of the sum of all of them, with per-command results unchanged.
acceptanceClaim: A single regression run measures the same command plan serially and in parallel, prints both durations and the speedup, and asserts that every command produces an identical pass/fail outcome in both modes.
